rows.name: in_scope
rows.calculation: if(((${patient_age_in_months} != '' and ${patient_age_in_months} >= 2) and (${patient_age_in_months} != '' and ${patient_age_in_months} < 60)), 'yes', if(((${patient_age_in_months} != '' and ${patient_age_in_months} < 2) or (${patient_age_in_months} != '' and ${patient_age_in_months} >= 60)), 'no', 'unknown'))

rows.name: has_cough_or_difficult_breathing
rows.label::en: Does the child have cough or difficult breathing?

rows.name: not_able_to_drink_or_breastfeed
rows.label::en: Is the child NOT able to drink or breastfeed?

rows.name: lethargic_or_unconscious
rows.label::en: Is the child lethargic or unconscious?

rows.name: breaths_per_minute
rows.label::en: Count the breaths in one minute. How many breaths per minute?
rows.hint::en: The child must be calm while you count.
rows.constraint_message::en: Enter a value of at least 0.

rows.name: stridor_in_calm_child
rows.label::en: Do you hear stridor while the child is calm?

rows.name: fast_breathing
rows.calculation: if((((${patient_age_in_months} != '' and ${patient_age_in_months} < 12) and (${breaths_per_minute} != '' and ${breaths_per_minute} >= 50)) or ((${patient_age_in_months} != '' and ${patient_age_in_months} >= 12) and (${breaths_per_minute} != '' and ${breaths_per_minute} >= 40))), 'yes', if((((${patient_age_in_months} != '' and ${patient_age_in_months} >= 12) or (${breaths_per_minute} != '' and ${breaths_per_minute} < 50)) and ((${patient_age_in_months} != '' and ${patient_age_in_months} < 12) or (${breaths_per_minute} != '' and ${breaths_per_minute} < 40))), 'no', ''))

rows.name: any_general_danger_sign
rows.calculation: if((selected(${not_able_to_drink_or_breastfeed}, 'yes') or selected(${vomits_everything}, 'yes') or selected(${had_convulsions}, 'yes') or selected(${lethargic_or_unconscious}, 'yes') or selected(${convulsing_now}, 'yes')), 'yes', if((selected(${not_able_to_drink_or_breastfeed}, 'no') and selected(${vomits_everything}, 'no') and selected(${had_convulsions}, 'no') and selected(${lethargic_or_unconscious}, 'no') and selected(${convulsing_now}, 'no')), 'no', ''))

rows.name: classification
rows.calculation: if(${in_scope} = 'unknown', 'age_unknown', if(${in_scope} = 'no', 'out_of_scope', if(selected(${has_cough_or_difficult_breathing}, 'no'), 'not_in_pathway', if((selected(${has_cough_or_difficult_breathing}, 'yes') and (${any_general_danger_sign} = 'yes' or selected(${stridor_in_calm_child}, 'yes'))), 'severe_pneumonia_or_very_severe_disease', if((selected(${has_cough_or_difficult_breathing}, 'yes') and ${any_general_danger_sign} = 'no' and selected(${stridor_in_calm_child}, 'no') and (selected(${chest_indrawing}, 'yes') or ${fast_breathing} = 'yes')), 'pneumonia', if((selected(${has_cough_or_difficult_breathing}, 'yes') and ${any_general_danger_sign} = 'no' and selected(${stridor_in_calm_child}, 'no') and selected(${chest_indrawing}, 'no') and ${fast_breathing} = 'no'), 'cough_or_cold', 'incomplete'))))))

rows.name: outcome_severe_pneumonia_or_very_severe_disease
rows.label::en: SEVERE PNEUMONIA OR VERY SEVERE DISEASE Refer URGENTLY to hospital.

rows.name: outcome_cough_or_cold
rows.label::en:
**COUGH OR COLD**
Follow up in 5 days if not improving.

rows.name: outcome_not_in_pathway
rows.label::en:
**No cough or difficult breathing**
This form does not assess other problems.

rows.name: outcome_out_of_scope
rows.label::en:
**Outside the 2 months to 5 years age range**
No classification was made.

rows.name: outcome_age_unknown
rows.label::en:
**No date of birth recorded**
No classification was made.

rows.name: outcome_incomplete
rows.label::en:
**Assessment incomplete**
Not all answers needed for a classification were given.
